name: document-delivery
title: Document Delivery
description: Fixed-fee document projects (contingency plans, audits, reports, policies): Project Management, then Gather requirements, Produce the document and Finalise, with milestones for draft issued and sign-off. Acceptance criteria sit in each description because templates can't create todos. Apply it before adding tickets by hand: a ticket created by hand is only reused if its title matches the template's exactly.

variables.name: document_name
variables.description: What the document is, in lower case, e.g. security contingency plan

variables.name: client_code
variables.description: TSD's short code for the client, used for their support address ({{client_code}}@tsd.support), e.g. tw

variables.name: contributor_count
variables.description: Number of third parties who need to provide input (agency, host, client teams). One Question ticket is created per contributor.

variables.name: section_count
variables.description: Number of main content sections to write. One Write ticket is created per section.

variables.name: delivery_list
variables.description: Task list (project phase) for the work

tasks.title: Project Management
tasks.description:
### Overview

Project management for the {{client_name}} {{document_name}}: kick-off, client updates, invoicing and handover.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Project set up in Productive
- New-client onboarding done where needed
- Kick-off held and owner, reviewer and dates agreed
- Contributor contacts received
- Time tracked within the fixed-fee budget
- Document signed off by the client
- Invoice raised and sent
- Handover complete
- All subtasks completed

subtasks.title: Finish setting up the project in Productive
subtasks.description:
### Overview

The project already exists (this template was applied to it), so finish it off: the fixed-fee budget and service, dates, the TSD team as members, the client's people with client access.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Budget and service match the SoW
- Start and target sign-off dates set
- Author and reviewer added as members
- Client contacts have client access

subtasks.title: Internal kick-off: agree owner, reviewer and dates
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Confirm the author and an independent technical reviewer, set target dates and split the fixed-fee budget across the tickets.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Author and reviewer named
- Target dates set, working back from sign-off
- Budget split confirmed against the ticket estimates

subtasks.title: Question: Is {{client_name}} a new client?
subtasks.description:
### Overview

New clients need onboarding; existing clients already have it. If {{client_name}} is new, do the steps below as part of this ticket (or split them into tasks). If not, check their support address still routes and close this.

### Acceptance Criteria

- New or existing client confirmed
- New clients only: support email address {{client_code}}@tsd.support set up and routing into the TSD helpdesk
- New clients only: Welcome Pack created (who's who, communication, how to raise support requests, how sign-off works)
- New clients only: Welcome Pack shared with the client

subtasks.title: Ask the client for contributor contacts
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Get named contacts for every third party who needs to provide input. Delivery timelines often start from this point, so send it first.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Request sent to the client
- All contributor contacts received
- Date received logged here

subtasks.title: Weekly status update to the client
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Short weekly note on progress, blockers and next steps.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Update sent each week until sign-off
- Blockers named with the party they are waiting on

subtasks.title: Raise and send the {{document_name}} invoice
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Raise the invoice per the SoW terms. Check billing contact, address and VAT treatment.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Invoicing trigger met (e.g. sign-off)
- Invoice raised with the correct VAT treatment
- Invoice sent to the client's accounts contact

subtasks.title: Hand over to ongoing support or service
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Make sure whoever uses the document day to day has it and is briefed. Close this if there is no follow-on service.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Final document stored in the project
- Relevant team briefed

tasks.title: 1. Gather the requirements for the {{document_name}}
tasks.description:
### Overview

Gather everything needed to write the {{document_name}}: the current state and input from each contributor. Paste the agreed scope from the SoW here.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Current-state inventory complete
- Input received from every contributor
- Gaps and open questions logged for the writing stage
- All subtasks completed

subtasks.title: Compile the current-state inventory
subtasks.description:
### Overview

List everything the document needs to cover from existing notes, calls and our own checks.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Every in-scope item listed with version, owner and location
- Open questions passed to the contributor questions

subtasks.title: Question: contributor {{repeat_index}} input
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Rename with the contributor's name and list the questions for them.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Questions sent
- Answers received
- Any commitments (e.g. response times) recorded

tasks.title: 2. Produce the {{document_name}} document
tasks.description:
### Overview

Write the {{document_name}} from the gathered inputs, with an independent technical review and a proofread before it goes to the client.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Structure agreed
- Inputs reviewed and assumptions logged
- All sections written
- Technical review complete and comments addressed
- Proofread complete
- All subtasks completed

subtasks.title: Agree the document structure and template
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- Headings map to each part of the agreed scope
- Document started in the TSD branded template

subtasks.title: Review the inputs and log gaps and assumptions
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- All inputs read and cross-checked
- Gaps chased or written in as assumptions

subtasks.title: Write: section {{repeat_index}}
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Rename with the section heading and add its acceptance criteria.

subtasks.title: QC: Technical review of the draft
subtasks.description:
### Overview

Independent review by someone other than the author.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Technical accuracy checked
- Comments addressed by the author

subtasks.title: Proofread for UK English and plain wording
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- UK English spelling throughout
- Plain wording for the audience
- Names, contacts and versions consistent

tasks.title: 3. Finalise and sign off the {{document_name}}
tasks.description:
### Overview

Share the draft, run the agreed review round and get written sign-off.

### Acceptance Criteria

- Draft issued
- Feedback consolidated
- Amendments applied
- Final version issued as a PDF
- Written sign-off received
- All subtasks completed

subtasks.title: Issue the draft for review
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- Draft sent with a feedback deadline
- Number of included review rounds stated

subtasks.title: Consolidate feedback from the review round
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- All feedback in one list
- Out-of-scope requests flagged as change requests

subtasks.title: Apply amendments
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- Every agreed comment addressed
- Version number and date updated

subtasks.title: Issue the final version and get written sign-off
subtasks.description:
### Acceptance Criteria

- Final version sent as a PDF
- Editable source stored in the project
- Written sign-off received
